fields.description: What the work itself came to — piece units at the piece rate, hours at the hourly rate, break pay and the overtime premium — before the minimum wage floor was applied. Gross Pay is this plus Minimum Wage Makeup.
fields.label: Earned Gross

fields.description: What was added to reach the minimum wage for the hours worked, per state, with the overtime premium in the floor. FLSA §6, ORS 653.025, RCW 49.46.020. Anything other than zero here is a pay rate set below what the hours are owed — the worker is paid correctly and the rate is the thing to look at.
fields.label: Minimum Wage Makeup

fields.description: Federal withholding, state withholding, Social Security and Medicare — the deductions the law requires, on their own. Every release before garnishments existed had this equal to Total Deductions; a report that read the total as 'taxes' should read this instead.
fields.label: Statutory Deductions

fields.description: Every garnishment and voluntary deduction on this slip, summed. Total Deductions is this plus Statutory Deductions, and Net Pay is gross less Total Deductions — so this is inside the total and inside what the worker is handed. The itemised lines are in the State Taxes Detail JSON under `_deduction_lines`.
fields.label: Total Other Deductions

fields.description: Deductions taken out of the WAGE BASE before withholding was computed — 401(k) deferrals, Section 125 premiums, HSA and FSA contributions.
fields.label: Pre-Tax Deductions

fields.description: Deductions taken after tax: garnishments, life insurance, union dues.
fields.label: Post-Tax Deductions

fields.description: Court-ordered and statutory withholding paid to somebody other than the worker: child support, tax levies, student loans, creditor garnishments. Bounded by the CCPA ceilings (15 U.S.C. 1673); where an order asked for more than the ceiling allowed, the difference is in the State Taxes Detail JSON under `_deduction_shortfalls` and is NOT carried into the next period.
fields.label: Garnishments

fields.description: The worker's own elections, pre-tax and post-tax together.
fields.label: Voluntary Deductions

fields.description: Gross less every pre-tax deduction: the base federal income tax was computed on. W-2 Box 1 is built from this.
fields.label: Federal Taxable Gross

fields.description: Gross less only the pre-tax deductions that leave the FICA base too. IT DIFFERS FROM FEDERAL TAXABLE GROSS BY EXACTLY THE 401(k) DEFERRAL — a Section 125 premium leaves both bases, a traditional 401(k) deferral leaves the income tax base and stays in this one (IRC 402(e)(3), 3121(v)(1)(A)). W-2 Box 3 is built from this, and Box 1 and Box 3 are supposed to differ by the deferral.
fields.label: FICA Taxable Gross

fields.description: Gross less the withholding the law requires, and nothing else — 29 CFR 870.10(a). The figure every CCPA garnishment ceiling is measured against. Voluntary deductions do NOT reduce it, however pre-tax they are: an employee cannot shrink the base a court order is measured against by raising their own contribution rate.
fields.label: Disposable Earnings

fields.description: What the farm owes ON TOP of gross pay. Not deducted from anybody — every figure here is an expense and a liability, and none of it changes net pay. Recorded from v0.40.0; slips written before that release carry zeros because the engine computed these and the record had nowhere to keep them.
fields.label: Employer Taxes

fields.description: The farm's matching 1.45%. Additional Medicare is employee-only and has no match.
fields.label: Medicare (Employer)

fields.description: Federal unemployment, employer-only, on the first $7,000 of each worker's annual gross.
fields.label: FUTA

fields.description: State unemployment insurance at this employer's own assigned rate. Zero unless a SUTA rate is set on the State Tax Configuration.
fields.label: State Unemployment (SUTA)

fields.description: State employer taxes that are not unemployment: Paid Leave Oregon's employer share, Oregon workers' compensation, WA PFML's employer share and the WA L&I employer rate.
fields.label: Other State Employer Taxes

fields.description: The four above plus the state employer total. Gross pay plus this is what the worker actually costs.
fields.label: Total Employer Taxes
